subject: ela
cluster: Range of reading and level of text complexity
intro: Read each passage and pick the answer.

items.prompt:
Read.

Maya shared her lunch with a hungry classmate all week.

Maya is:
A) selfish
B) kind
C) lazy

Read.

Dark clouds gathered and thunder rumbled as night fell.

The mood is:
A) cheerful
B) tense/gloomy
C) silly

steps: Setting creates tension. Key is B.

items.prompt:
To support an answer about a story, a good reader uses:
A) guesses
B) details from the text
C) the cover price

steps: Use text evidence. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

When the flood came, Omar ignored his fear and rowed out again and again to save his neighbors.

Omar shows:
A) bravery
B) laziness
C) fear only

steps: He faces danger to help. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

Even after losing twice, Priya trained harder and entered again.

Priya shows:
A) determination
B) carelessness
C) sadness

steps: She keeps trying. Key is A.

items.prompt:
Read.

The boy bragged he never lost, until a quiet girl beat him.

The theme is:
A) bragging wins
B) don't be overconfident
C) games are boring

steps: Lesson about humility. Key is B.

items.prompt:
Read.

The miser hid his gold and trusted no one. In the end, he died alone, with no friends to mourn him.

The BEST theme is:
A) Gold brings happiness
B) Greed and selfishness lead to loneliness
C) Always hide your money
items.answer: B) Greed and selfishness lead to loneliness

steps: His greed left him alone. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) Greed and selfishness lead to loneliness

items.prompt:
Read.

The farmer planted trees he would never see grow, so his grandchildren could enjoy their shade.

Which theme fits BEST?
A) Giving to the future is worthwhile
B) Trees are tall
C) Farming is hard work only
items.answer: A) Giving to the future is worthwhile

steps: Selfless, future-minded giving. Key is A.
solution.answer: A) Giving to the future is worthwhile
